snippet.title: Bootstrap Island First Post-Launch Update Announcement | VR Games Showcase March 2026
snippet.description:
Get Bootstrap Island on PC VR with PS VR2 coming soon: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1942110/Bootstrap_Island/

A Robinson Crusoe–inspired VR roguelike survival adventure set in the 17th century. Shipwrecked on a ruthless tropical island, you must survive without guidance. Trust your instincts as you face wild beasts, nature’s fury, and a mysterious local tribe.
